text:
maria: Hey docs team — I'm kicking off a small refresh of the Hello Quickstart to clarify auth and first deployment. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3245. Main goals: make auth snippets use SDK v4 token flow, add a minimal Dockerfile for the hello app, and fix the broken link to /getting-started/auth. Please skim and flag any UX/accuracy issues.

alex: on it. I'll audit JS + Python snippets and check env var names. Prefer to keep CLI minimal.

sam: I'll run the steps locally, re-do the deploy steps and note any gotchas. If I hit 401s I'll paste logs.

docs-bot: PR opened by maria in docs repo: #3245 "hello-quickstart: auth & deploy refresh" (draft) — reviewers: alex, sam

maria: quick checklist: 1) update js/python snippets to sdk v4 style 2) unify env var name to REDWOOD_API_KEY 3) add minimal Dockerfile + run instructions 4) fix /getting-started/auth link 5) add 'expected output' snippet for success response

alex: nit: current python snippet uses CLIENT_TOKEN variable name, will change to REDWOOD_API_KEY and push tiny patch. Also the Node example should show streaming vs non-streaming minimal switch.

sam: ran steps, hitting 401 at 'curl http://localhost:8080/generate' — curl used wrong header. Log:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"missing Authorization header"}
```
I'll paste the failing curl and a corrected variant in the PR comment.

maria: thanks @alex @sam — I'll update curl example to include `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` and add a short troubleshooting note for 401s.

alex: also suggest adding a single-line 'what next' pointing to the Console and Dedicated pages, makes it easier for teams deciding next steps.

maria: plan: finish patches today, tag @leo for final review, and merge once CI/docs lint pass. Target EOD Friday. @leo can you review tomorrow morning?

leo: yep, will review first thing tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome. I'll add a small 'migration note' for folks moving from SDK3 to SDK4 and mark the PR ready once patches are pushed.
